status_summary: CNN reported on 2025-04-10, from anonymous sources, that access to the PDB had been tightly restricted, with the Chief of Staff approving recipients early in the term and the DNI deciding who receives it since February 2025; a DNI spokesperson said the director was updating outdated processes. On 2025-05-13 the DNI decided, and her office announced internally, that PDB production would move from CIA headquarters to ODNI headquarters (New York Times, 2025-05-15), and ODNI said in an email reported by AP on 2025-05-14 that the staff who prepare the brief were moving from CIA to ODNI buildings. A CIA memo described to the Times said transition timelines and processes remained to be worked out and that CIA's analysis directorate would keep a supporting role. Whether the relocation was completed, the current recipient list, and whether briefers from agencies other than CIA were adopted were not found.

timeline.event: CNN reported, from anonymous sources, that the administration had tightly restricted who can see the PDB, with the DNI deciding recipients since February 2025; an early proposal to limit it to a handful of senior officials was not confirmed as adopted.

The DNI decided to move PDB production, and the National Intelligence Council, from CIA headquarters to ODNI headquarters, and her office announced the PDB move internally, per the New York Times report of 2025-05-15.
AP reported, citing an ODNI email, that the staff who prepare the PDB were being moved from CIA locations to ODNI buildings, giving the DNI more direct control of the brief.

title: Narrow the PDB distribution and put all PDB staff and production at ODNI
uncertainties: All sources are press accounts; the relocation is attributed to ODNI itself (an ODNI email reported by AP and an on-record ODNI official quoted by the Times), while the distribution restriction rests on anonymous sources. No ODNI public statement was found and the ODNI 2.0 fact sheet does not mention the PDB. A search for completion of the move or for a non-CIA briefer found nothing newer than May 2025, and DNI Gabbard, who made the decisions, left office in June 2026 (per c07-01). The stage reflects two of the three elements (narrower distribution and the ODNI move) as announced or reported, neither confirmed complete, and none of the third; 55 was lowered to 40 for that reason.
